predeclared.note: Written BEFORE any R3_twoway strategy number was computed. Only exploration done before: index availability and Nifty 50 futures carry (DEV: futures index 5.6%/yr vs spot 13.0%/yr, mean daily fut-spot gap -6.85%/yr, 1D rate 6.35%/yr, Nifty 50 dividend yield ~1.0-1.2%) to set cost conventions.

prereg_list.BASE: frozen PROD long book (top-20, weekly, 4 sleeves, 20d time exit, liq2, cash, 50 bps), unhedged
prereg_list.D0: avoid veto only: EW elig_base minus PROD bottom 30% (select_quantile=(0.3,1), sizing equal) vs EW universe
prereg_list.D1a: BASE + short Nifty 50 futures, hedge ratio 1.0, weekly
prereg_list.D1b: BASE + short Nifty 50 futures, ex-ante rolling 60d beta (data <= t-1), weekly
prereg_list.D1c: as D1b with Nifty Midcap Select (synthetic futures)
prereg_list.D2-K10-cash/D2-K10-fut/D2-K20-cash/D2-K2: F&O long top-K / short bottom-K (stock futures), dollar-neutral; long leg cash 50 bps or futures 25 bps
prereg_list.D3: BASE (full liq2, cash) + 50% overlay short of F&O bottom-20 (stock futures)
prereg_list.D4: F&O short-only bottom-20 (stock futures) on cash collateral

predeclared.variants_count_rule: 10 pre-declared strategy variants + at most 1 extra (X1) = 11; 80 bps stress runs are stress tests of the same variants
conventions: C1 phase averaging: 5 weekly entry phases, daily returns averaged; hedges rebalanced on each phase's own weekly signal dates; DEV 2023-01-01..2025-12-31 (exits by DEV end), 2026 = 2026-01-01..2026-10-14 fresh books, plus one contiguous 2023-01-01..2026-10-14 run for charts and ex-ante beta.

C2 index hedge: notional = beta x long-book value reset at each weekly signal close; fixed units between resets, MTM settled daily in cash; P&L from 'Nifty 50 Futures Index' (embeds realised basis/roll); costs 1 bp x |delta notional| per weekly reset (incl. initial) + 2 bps x notional on the last trading day of each month; margin 15% of notional, half (7.5%) cash earning Nifty 1D Rate; long book scaled to 1/(1+0.075 beta) at each reset; no stock cost for that tiny re-scaling (absorbed by weekly sleeve rebalance).
C3 ex-ante beta: OLS beta of the phase-averaged contiguous unhedged BASE daily returns on the hedge instrument over the 60 trading days ending t-1; beta=1.0 until 40 obs; clipped [0,2].

C4 Midcap Select: synthetic futures r = r(Nifty Midcap Select price) - (r_1D - 0.0107/252 per day); q=1.07%/yr = mean Nifty 50 dividend yield from 'Nifty50 Dividend Points' (assumed same for MIDCPNIFTY); same costs/margin as C2; liquidity caveat.

C5 stock-futures legs: same staggered-sleeve engine as L.Sim (4 sleeves, weekly, 20d time exit, forced exit at last valid close on suspension/label_block, slot sizing 1/K); picks top/bottom-K by PROD within fno_proxy & elig_base; short P&L = -(CA-adjusted total return) + Nifty 1D Rate carry while held; futures long pays the carry; futures 25 bps RT per leg, cash long 50 bps (half entry/half exit, multiplicative as L.Sim).

C6 stock-futures margin (NOT in mandate, assumption): 25% of notional, half in cash earning 1D rate, half by pledging cash-long shares; cash-long books scaled to 1/(1+0.125 x short notional per unit long); futures-long D2: legs at 1.0x equity each, all equity collateral at 1D rate; D4: short notional 1.0x equity, all equity collateral at 1D rate.
C7 idle cash inside the long book follows frozen L.Sim (0 yield) so BASE is bit-identical; margin/collateral cash earns the 1D rate.

C8 baselines (not variants): BASE, 5-seed random top-20 (liq2), EW universe, Nifty 500 price, cash (1D rate); for short legs a 5-seed random F&O short basket and random F&O long/short with the same engine/costs/carry/margin.

C9 adoption rule (PREREG, binding): DEV phase-averaged daily gain vs BASE with paired NW t>=2 (lag 20) and maxDD worsening <= 3 pp; D0 judged vs EW universe (round-2 definition). Risk-reduction stats reported but cannot override the rule.
Stress 80 bps: cash legs 80 bps; futures legs scaled by 80/50 (40 bps); hedge costs x1.6.

Outcome tables: elig_base rows with valid 20d window; net = open[t+1]->close[t+20] - 50 bps; PROD deciles per date among elig_base rows with finite PROD (ex-ante); label classes ex-post (coherence only); market states from PIT mkt_dist_sma200 and mkt_mom20 at t.

extra_variants.X1: D2-K20-cash-beta: short notional per sleeve scaled by mean beta_60(long picks)/mean beta_60(short picks) at the signal date, clipped [0.5,1.5]. Reason: a dollar-neutral L/S whose short basket has higher beta is net short the market (boring beta explanation). Run once; adopted only under C9.

notes: net = open[t+1]->close[t+20] - 0.005 (CA-adjusted, incl. dividends); rows = elig_base with valid 20d window
label classes are realised (ex-post); PROD deciles are ex-ante (per-date rank among elig_base rows with finite PROD)
F&O deciles re-ranked within fno_proxy & elig_base; short_net = -r + Nifty 1D Rate carry over the window - 25 bps
overlapping 20d windows: rows are not independent; spread t-stats use every 20th date (non-overlap) and NW lag 20

predeclared_amendment.note: Written before running B1/B2. After seeing that the F&O bottom-20 short picks are high-vol (xs pct 0.76) and high-beta (0.64), test whether the avoid veto D0 is a boring low-vol/low-beta tilt. B1/B2 are diagnostic baselines (not adoption candidates) but are counted as extra variants (X1 + B1 + B2 = 3, the maximum).
predeclared_amendment.B1: EW elig_base minus top-30% vol_20 (score = -vol_20, select_quantile=(0.3,1), sizing equal, step 5, 50/80 bps)
predeclared_amendment.B2: EW elig_base minus top-30% beta_60 (score = -beta_60, same settings)
predeclared_amendment.test: OLS of daily (D0 - EW) on (B - EW) with intercept; NW t (lag 20) of the intercept (residual avoid alpha)

summary.variants_detail: 10 pre-declared strategies (D0, D1a, D1b, D1c, D2 x4, D3, D4) + 3 extra (X1 beta-matched D2; B1 vol-veto, B2 beta-veto diagnostics); each at 50 and 80 bps; baselines (BASE, EW, random top-20, random shorts) not counted

html_tables.title: What each realised label class meant in money (20-day hold, after 50 bps)
html_tables.note: Realised (ex-post) classes of the frozen XR_neumom h=20 label. Net = buy at next open, sell at close 20 trading days later, minus 50 bps. The label is relative, but the classes are strongly separated in absolute money too. These classes are known only afterwards; the tradable version is the score deciles below.

html_tables.title: Tradable signal: 20-day net return by PROD score decile (all eligible stocks)
html_tables.note: Deciles formed each day from the frozen PROD score (known at the close). DEV spread t = 2.32 (non-overlapping), deciles perfectly ordered (rank corr 1.00); 2026 spread t = 1.94, rank corr 0.47. Even the bottom decile is roughly break-even in absolute terms: the low side is 'worse than the rest', rarely 'falls in absolute terms'.

html_tables.title: Inside the F&O list (where single-stock shorting is possible) the signal is weak
columns: Bottom decile as a futures short: mean net
html_tables.note: PROD re-ranked within fno_proxy (top-200 by turnover) and eligible names. Short net = minus the stock's 20-day return plus the futures carry (Nifty 1D Rate) minus 25 bps. Shorting the model's bottom decile loses money on average in both windows; in 2026 the bottom F&O decile actually rose the most.

html_tables.title: Does the signal depend on the market state? (known at the signal date)
html_tables.note: States use the Nifty 500 at the signal close. The spread (top minus bottom) is positive in every state in both windows but not significant below the 200-dma (DEV non-overlap t 0.65); the absolute level of every group moves with the market. Share of signal dates above the 200-dma: DEV 0.83, 2026 0.44.
